item.title: OR in Medicine and Health Care
item.content:encoded:
Eva K. Lee, Georgia Institute of Technology

Ariela Sofer, George Mason University

This special section seeks contributions applying optimization and computational methods to medical and healthcare challenges. The collection welcomes theoretical and methodological work on models and algorithms including continuous linear and nonlinear optimization, integer programming, combinatorial optimization, and stochastic approaches applied to medical and biological problems. Applications span disease modeling, diagnosis, treatment planning, imaging, epidemiology, and molecular biology.

The partnership between mathematical programming researchers and medical professionals—clinicians, biologists, public health officials—creates opportunities to advance both optimization theory and practice while addressing important healthcare problems. The special section, established in 2000, publishes state-of-the-art research in this dynamic field on an ongoing basis.

Original, previously unpublished manuscripts submitted to this collection are evaluated through standard peer review by the Annals of Operations Research.
